representation_fit.evidence: Brief shape=relational-web, job=understand/followable dependencies. Implementation is a directional dependency graph: 28 nodes / 55 edges with arrow semantics ('A→B 表示 A 依赖 B', legend in both screenshots; source/index.html:16), type-colored node classes (source/js/app.js:12-15), edge strength rendering (app.js:73-77), and BFS upstream/downstream traversal as first-class operations (source/js/graph.js:32-56). Relationships themselves are the content, matching the brief's discriminator.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Both screenshots: the graph canvas dominates (~70% of viewport) on load with the whole 28-node web already laid out and usable (no loading state, index.html:72-74 loads data synchronously); the header subtitle states the exact task '关系跟随不丢失全局上下文 · 28 节点 · 55 关系'; the breadcrumb bar and right-panel guide both lead with the follow workflow (选中→跟随→不迷路).

time_to_understand.evidence: Initial screen is self-explanatory within seconds: 3-step guide in inspector (index.html:61-65), legend explains arrow direction and thick=strong (index.html:48), breadcrumb bar states current mode ('未在跟随——…'). Deduction: node text renders very small at default fit zoom — receipt check 'type.min_projected_size' fail (measurement-summary.json), and the central edge crossing is dense in both screenshots, requiring zoom to read labels.

navigation_cost.evidence: Single screen; primary object reachable in one interaction: node click selects (app.js:111), then one click on 追踪上游依赖/追踪下游影响 (app.js:385-386, 473-485). Search with ↑↓/Enter jump (index.html:20, app.js:536-542), minimap click re-centers viewport (app.js:205-213), breadcrumb chips jump between hops (app.js:341-343). No modes or page transitions.

context_loss.evidence: Core design constraint is context preservation: during a trace, non-closure nodes/edges are dimmed to opacity .15/.13 but never hidden (style.css:145,169; app.js:1-3 comment '降不透明度但不隐藏'); breadcrumb records every hop with clickable chips to step back (app.js:316-348); distance badges per node (app.js:289-295); minimap always shows whole graph plus trace closure and viewport rect (app.js:222-249). All primary actions occur in the persistent side panel without leaving the canvas.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces are few and task-serving: header (search + 3 view buttons), breadcrumb bar, canvas, legend, minimap, inspector (index.html:11-70); only 3 view controls total (style.css:88-96). Deduction: two permanent surfaces duplicate the same idle onboarding copy (breadcrumb bar '未在跟随——…' vs inspector guide steps, visible in both screenshots), and the always-on legend/minimap overlays occlude edge paths in the lower canvas (1280x860 screenshot).

accessibility.evidence: All three a11y receipt checks failed: 'a11y.contrast': fail, 'a11y.focus_order': fail, 'a11y.target_size': fail, plus 'type.min_projected_size': fail (measurement-summary.json). Mitigating structure exists in source (role=button + tabindex + Enter/Space on nodes app.js:89,112-114; aria-live status index.html:33; listbox/option search index.html:21; focus-visible outlines style.css:96,116,245,268), but faint grays (style.css:10 --faint #8b94a8 at 10.5px, style.css:173), small chips (style.css:111-114) and 2.8-4px minimap dots (app.js:229-234) are consistent with the failures.

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects at either viewport: layout.overflow pass, layout.responsive_collision pass, text.truncation pass (measurement-summary.json); both screenshots show a clean centered DAG, intact panels, no truncation. However 4 of 7 checks failed (a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size), which are real defects implying remediation work, though none are layout rework.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '关系跟随不丢失全局上下文' is explicitly engineered: it is the subtitle (index.html:16); BFS closure with step-by-step expansion and '到底' (app.js:455-466, 383-391); '经由路径' chain display (app.js:402-411); per-hop breadcrumb, distance badges, minimap closure highlighting; algorithm unit tests all PASS covering up/down traversal, concrete paths, closure monotonicity, deterministic layout (source/evidence-test-log.txt:1-23). URL state (?select&trace&steps&path) supports evidence reproduction (app.js:559-578).

defects_observed: Receipt failures: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size all fail (measurement-summary.json checks)
Node sub-labels at 10.5px in faint #8b94a8 (source/css/style.css:10,173) and small targets (breadcrumb chips style.css:111-114, minimap dots app.js:232) match the failed checks
Idle breadcrumb bar and inspector guide duplicate the same onboarding instructions (both screenshots; index.html:30-34 vs 58-65)
Legend and minimap overlays occlude edge paths in the lower canvas region (1280x860 screenshot)
scores.overall_note: A single-screen dependency-graph explorer that matches the brief's relational-web shape directly: 28 nodes and 55 directional edges render fully on load, with upstream/downstream BFS tracing as the dominant workflow and an explicit 3-step guide. The acceptance seed ('relationship following without losing global context') is addressed structurally on three channels — dim-but-never-hide rendering, per-hop clickable breadcrumb with distance badges, and an always-visible minimap marking trace closure and viewport — and is backed by 21 passing unit tests on traversal, paths, closure monotonicity, and deterministic layout. Navigation cost is minimal (click node, click trace; plus search, minimap, and breadcrumb shortcuts) and no layout defects are visible at either viewport. The clear weakness is accessibility: all three a11y receipt checks (contrast, focus order, target size) fail along with projected text size, consistent with faint 10.5px sub-labels and small chips/dots in the source. Model-judged time-to-understand is strong but the proxy label applies; no human preference, task time, or retrieval accuracy is observable in this blind package.
